- Check the tyre tread is not worn.

Some types of tyre are fitted with wear indicators; they should be replaced as soon as these indicators are visible on the tread.

Do not swap tyres across.

- Check the tyre inflation pressure is correct. Also check the spare wheel.

The tyre pressures must be checked when they are cold.

- Check that the lighting system is operating correctly: headlamps, turn signals, hazard lights, luggage compartment light, passenger compartment light, oddment compartment light and instrument panel warning lights.
- Check the windscreen wiper system is operating correctly and adjust the sprays if necessary.
- Check the front and rear wiper blades are correctly positioned and not worn.
- Check condition and wear of front disc brake pads and operation of pad wear indicator
- Carry out a visual check of: exterior bodywork, underbody protection, rigid and flexible pipes (exhaust - fuel system - braking system) rubber elements (boots - hoses - bushes - etc.)
- Check cleanliness of locks, bonnet and boot lids, cleanliness and lubrication of linkage

- Check and, if necessary, top up the engine fluid levels: brakes/clutch,

Op. 0010T64 BRAKE AND/OR CLUTCH FLUID CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP AS NECESSARY

power steering,

Op. 0010T71 POWER STEERING FLUID CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP IF NECESSARY

windscreen washer, battery, engine cooling, etc.
- Visually check the power assisted steering system seal.

- Check/adjust handbrake lever travel

Op. 3380A04 HANDBRAKE - ADJUST TRAVEL

- Check and, if necessary, adjust the tappet clearance.

Op. 1036H10 VALVE TAPPETS - CHECK AND ADJUST CLEARANCE, IF NECESSARY

- Check exhaust emissions

Op. 1080A10 IDLING C.O. LEVEL - CHECK WITH SPECIAL EQUIPMENT

- Replace the accessory drive belt

Op. 1092G10 SINGLE ENGINE BELT - R.R

- Replace the toothed timing belt.

Op. 1032B10 TOOTHED TIMING BELT - R + R FOR TIMING ADJUSTMENT OR REPLACEMENT

Regardless of the mileage, the timing belt must be changed every 4 years for heavy-duty use (cold climates, town use, long periods of idling) or at least every 5 years.

- Check and, if necessary, top up the automatic transmission fluid level.

Op. 0010T45 AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID CHECK LEVEL AND TOP UP IF NECESSARY

- Replace engine oil and filter

Op. 0010T12 ENGINE OIL AND FILTER - REPLACE

- Replace the pollen filter.

Op. 5010B08 CLIMATE CONTROL OUTSIDE AIR PURIFYING (POLLEN) FILTER - R.R.

Irrespective of the mileage, it should be replaced every 12 months.

- Connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment to the vehicle diagnostic socket and check the engine operation.

At the end of the service, connect the Examiner diagnostic equipment to the on board diagnostic socket to zero the mileage counter for the days to the starting value and write the details of the service that has been carried out (date, service no., total mileage) in the Trip Computer memory which can only be read using the diagnostic equipment.

Check that the figure has been set in the instrument panel in km or miles depending on the unit of measurement in that country.
